description: VRN und RNN GTFS-Sollfahrplandaten aktuell is a dataset listed in German national open data portal (GovData), an open data portal, published or maintained by Mobilithek. Der Verkehrsverbund Rhein-Neckar stellt die Fahrplandaten seines Verbundgebiets sowie die des RNN zur Ansicht und Weiterverarbeitung im offenen Standardformat GTFS (General Transit Feed Specification) zur Verfügung. Da es sich hierbei um Sollfahrplandaten handelt, wird es auch häufig als GTFS Static bezeichnet. Die Daten werden in sogenannten GTFS-Feeds zur Verfügung gestellt. Coverage: Mobilithek. The portal files it under the publisher Mobilithek. Its tags are gtfs, rnn, vrn. It offers 1 resource(s) in HTTP://PUBLICATIONS.EUROPA.EU/RESOURCE/AUTHORITY/FILE-TYPE/CSV. The portal shows 2026-09-25 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support public transport network, service and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-de-portal.
